justification: Both show the rear of a massive blocky humanoid statue with the identical set of low-relief motifs in the identical vertical order: paired ring/crescent forms at the shoulders, a central disc on the mid-back, downward-sweeping arcs forming a belt, and a small boss low down. The only differences are viewing angle, lighting and surrounding setting, not depicted content; this is to all appearances the same figure.
